Hero_Desc_Eisia:
CEO of 'Frost Nova,' the No. 2 company in Monatium.
She feels inferior to Meluna, the CEO of 'Melo Corporation', the top-ranked company.
She uses every means to defeat Meluna but always fails in absurd ways.
Album_Eisia1: Eisia is the CEO of a massive corporation that monopolizes the production and distribution of frozen products in Monatium. Unfortunately, Meluna monopolizes everything else, creating an enormous gap in their profits.
Album_Eisia2: Eisia was supposed to develop a new ice cream, but forgot several ingredients and submitted the resulting mistaken product to Elena for evaluation. That product became Monatium's space ration.
Album_Eisia3: Eisia is exceptionally harsh and coldhearted, firing employees for the smallest mistake. Yet leaving this exploitative company with severance pay is practically a blessing, so her actions ultimately amount to good deeds.
Album_Eisia4: Elena looks down on Eisia for possessing less wealth than Meluna. Eisia devises schemes to demonstrate her importance, but Elena always sees through them, leaving her with nothing to show for the effort.
Album_Eisia5: Eisia seems to possess extraordinary passion and affection for ice cream. She managed the freezer back on Earth, and her obsession with frozen food and ice cream continued after arriving in Elias.
Album_Eisia6: Strangely, the Elves of Monatium regard Eisia as warmhearted. Everything she did to defeat Meluna resulted in giveaways or lower prices, benefiting Monatium's citizens.
Album_Eisia7: Eisia enjoys looking like an evil CEO. If someone mistakenly praises her for being kind, her entire body trembles as she vehemently rejects the accusation.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Eisia: If you don't want to get fired, do your job properly, get it?

Eisia_SPSkill1: I will cool you right down!
Eisia_SPSkill1-01: I will cool you right down!
Eisia_Ultimate1: You will be chilled to the bone.

Eisia_Gacha3: You are lucky to meet a first-rate businesswoman.

Eisia_Line2: I will do anything if it lets me beat Meluna!
Eisia_Line3: Frost Nova is obviously better than Melu Corporation.

LoveLetter_Eisia:
Master, do you remember the first day I visited the banquet hall? The day I was completely exhausted.
Hearing your gentle voice in that cozy hall seemed to thaw my rigid body and heart.

The time I spent with you then was time when I could focus entirely on myself. This is embarrassing to admit, but it felt so... warm.

So I am thinking of creating an ice cream that captures the warmth I felt in the banquet hall. Warm ice cream. Would that not be sensational? You will be the first to taste it once it is complete.
Look forward to it. Hehe.
LoveCall_Eisia:
Master! Do you know what happened today? Listen!

As part of my work, I thoroughly emptied the company suggestion box and checked every note. One of them actually thanked me!
Every other note was criticism, but... anyway, at last someone besides you recognizes my efforts! Ahaha!

So, well, perhaps I wanted to brag... I wanted to tell you too.
When you praised me in the banquet hall before, it was embarrassing... but honestly, I liked it.
I thought that telling you this might make you praise me again, just like then. That is why I called!

So, Master, you should come praise me immediately, right? Hehe.
I have specially prepared fifty ice cream samples, so report to Frost Nova at once!
You must leave tasting notes and praise me while you are here!
Affinity_Eisia_EP01_001: That was delicious! How much for one serving?
Affinity_Eisia_EP01_003: Hehe, sorry, but I carry no cash. I suppose that makes it free.
Affinity_Eisia_EP01_007: F-Free? Is this some kind of scheme?
Affinity_Eisia_EP02_001: What flavor of ice cream do you like, Master?
Affinity_Eisia_EP02_003: Strawberry flavor does not actually contain strawberries. Surprised?
Affinity_Eisia_EP02_005: As expected of the Master, you understand flavor. Vanilla is the best.
Affinity_Eisia_EP02_007: You... You said that on purpose!!
Affinity_Eisia_EP03_001: Master, would you like to work as an intern at my company?
Affinity_Eisia_EP03_002: You are not just trying to work me to the bone, are you?
Affinity_Eisia_EP03_003: Of course I am! That is what interns are for.
Affinity_Eisia_EP03_004: A permanent position is guaranteed, right?
Affinity_Eisia_EP03_005: If you work exceptionally hard, I will consider it.
Affinity_Eisia_EP03_006: I will devote my entire being to life as an intern!
Affinity_Eisia_EP03_007: If this were a real interview, that answer would earn full marks!
Affinity_Eisia_EP04_001: What do you think matters most when running a company?
Affinity_Eisia_EP04_003: Exactly! For reference, my conviction is 'Defeat Meluna'!
Affinity_Eisia_EP04_005: Kahahaha! You say the funniest things, Master.
Affinity_Eisia_EP04_006: Putting everything on the line matters.
Affinity_Eisia_EP04_007: Y-You would not last a month running a business that way!
Affinity_Eisia_EP05_001: Elena! Charging another penalty over something so trivial!
Affinity_Eisia_EP05_003: That makes her rather similar to me.
Affinity_Eisia_EP05_004: What illegal thing did you get caught doing?
Affinity_Eisia_EP05_005: That may be true, but she could overlook it at least once!
Affinity_Eisia_EP05_006: Other companies do not pay those penalties.
Affinity_Eisia_EP05_007: Ugh, Meluna! She must be bribing someone!
Affinity_Eisia_EP06_001: It is too hot inside. Would you like me to cool it down?
Affinity_Eisia_EP06_002: Are you going to tell an unfunny joke like Rim?
Affinity_Eisia_EP06_003: I overflow with wit. I have never told an unfunny joke!
Affinity_Eisia_EP06_004: Are you planning to fire your freeze cannon?
Affinity_Eisia_EP06_005: A direct hit would keep you cool for a week.
Affinity_Eisia_EP06_006: Are you going to buy me a refrigerator?
Affinity_Eisia_EP06_007: I cannot promise a refrigerator, but I can fire the freeze cannon for you.
Affinity_Eisia_EP07_002: She often sits exactly where you are sitting now.
Affinity_Eisia_EP07_004: Would you like to try the food Meluna ate?
Affinity_Eisia_EP07_005: It all tastes like melon! What does she see in this?
Affinity_Eisia_EP07_006: She says she is too afraid of you to come.
Affinity_Eisia_EP07_007: Hehe. I suppose I am rather frightening.
Affinity_Eisia_EP08_001: Several more employees quit. I wonder why.
Affinity_Eisia_EP08_002: Perhaps they moved to jobs with better conditions?
Affinity_Eisia_EP08_004: Perhaps they had already earned enough money.
Affinity_Eisia_EP08_005: Then reducing their salaries would make them work longer...!
Affinity_Eisia_EP08_007: Weekends are enough! Why would they need any more rest?!
Affinity_Eisia_EP09_001: I am exhausted... I worked overtime all night.
Affinity_Eisia_EP09_002: If you work overtime, the other employees must stay too.
Affinity_Eisia_EP09_003: They can learn so much by working overtime beside me. It is good for them!
Affinity_Eisia_EP09_004: Then have you remained awake without sleeping at all?
Affinity_Eisia_EP09_005: This is my third day without sleep... Ugh...
Affinity_Eisia_EP09_006: You truly are a workaholic. Impressive.
Affinity_Eisia_EP09_007: Hehe. Workaholic is a word that represents me.
Affinity_Eisia_EP10_001: Is there a way to improve my employees' efficiency?
Affinity_Eisia_EP10_002: Pay them according to how much they work.
Affinity_Eisia_EP10_003: Not some absurd solution like that!
Affinity_Eisia_EP10_004: Give them a sense of ownership!
Affinity_Eisia_EP10_005: Good. I should provide more thorough ideological training.
Affinity_Eisia_EP10_006: Let us monitor them twenty-four hours a day!
Affinity_Eisia_EP10_007: Then I would have to hire Elves to perform that monitoring for all twenty-four hours!
Affinity_Eisia_EP11_002: Why? Did Rim make you laugh?
Affinity_Eisia_EP11_003: Of course not?! I am Eisia, chairwoman of Frost Nova. Such lame lines could never appeal to my sense of humor!
Affinity_Eisia_EP11_004: That makes sense. Melo Corporation's stock price rose.
Affinity_Eisia_EP11_005: What?! How much did it rise? Why? Did Elena invest in them? Why am I only hearing about this now?! Aaargh!!!
Affinity_Eisia_EP11_007: I played rock-paper-scissors against Meluna in a dream and lost! I have to fall asleep again at once for a rematch!
Affinity_Eisia_EP12_001: I need someone capable of inheriting my company in preparation for the future...
Affinity_Eisia_EP12_003: Oh...? You are prepared to endure Eisia's Spartan training until the tears and snot pour out, right?
Affinity_Eisia_EP12_004: Is there anyone promising you have your eye on?
Affinity_Eisia_EP12_005: No. Is there no one as smart, cool, witty, talented at leadership, tasteful, hardworking, and perfect as I am~?
Affinity_Eisia_EP12_006: Why would you say that?! Hmph...
Affinity_Eisia_EP12_007: Huh? If you say that, Master, you make me sound like an Elf bound for the weekend farm tomorrow!
Affinity_Eisia_EP13_001: Is there a good decoration that could beautify my dreary chairwoman's office?
Affinity_Eisia_EP13_003: Would that not require constant care? What a nuisance... Ah! I can make my secretary do everything!
Affinity_Eisia_EP13_004: How about placing a doll there?
Affinity_Eisia_EP13_005: Barong has already left enough dolls to fill a truck... Something about the Doll King ordering it...
Affinity_Eisia_EP13_006: You are already a beautiful flower. What else do you need?
Affinity_Eisia_EP13_007: What?! Striking so suddenly is unfair! So, specifically, what kind of flower do I resemble? Hmm?
Affinity_Eisia_EP14_001: Which product from my company tastes best?
Affinity_Eisia_EP14_003: Our greatest contributor to sales, hehe! Do you like them with ketchup or mustard, Master?
Affinity_Eisia_EP14_005: Did you not say you were tired of eating so many sweets? Hehe. No one can resist ice cream after all~
Affinity_Eisia_EP14_006: I dislike frozen food, so I do not eat it.
Affinity_Eisia_EP14_007: That is because you have only tasted bad frozen food. Follow me at once. I will let you sample every food my company makes!
Affinity_Eisia_EP15_001: Why does work never end, no matter how much I do?
Affinity_Eisia_EP15_002: That is why it is work. You have to do it every day.
Affinity_Eisia_EP15_003: ...Wow... I see... Goodness... How astonishing... My... You are so clever, Master... Wow...
Affinity_Eisia_EP15_004: Get some rest. You need to consider your health.
Affinity_Eisia_EP15_005: But resting makes me anxious... They say that if you rest today, you must run tomorrow.
Affinity_Eisia_EP15_006: When there is no work, you create some just to keep working.
Affinity_Eisia_EP15_007: Another word for that is 'creative.' I cannot help it. I do not want this either, but what can I do when my mind works so smoothly on its own?
Affinity_Eisia_EP16_001: What ice cream flavor do you think I like most, Master?
Affinity_Eisia_EP16_002: You drink coffee during overtime every day, so coffee flavor.
Affinity_Eisia_EP16_003: Come now, coffee tastes best as a drink. Huh? Drinkable coffee ice cream? Should I make some?
Affinity_Eisia_EP16_004: Blue suits you, so... mint chocolate?
Affinity_Eisia_EP16_005: That is good too! Cool~ sweet~ and refreshing~! But it is not my favorite. Wrong!
Affinity_Eisia_EP16_006: Chocolate is the best ice cream flavor.
Affinity_Eisia_EP16_007: Exactly~ They say customization always ends by returning to the original. After trying everything else, one inevitably returns to chocolate.
Affinity_Eisia_EP17_001: How many times a week does Meluna come here?
Affinity_Eisia_EP17_002: She has been busy lately, so she rarely comes.
Affinity_Eisia_EP17_003: Hmm~ A poor mind makes the hands and feet suffer. She is so foolish that she creates more work for herself and becomes busy, right?
Affinity_Eisia_EP17_005: Why are you only telling me now?! Then I shall have to come at least four times every week. I cannot lose to Meluna!!
Affinity_Eisia_EP17_006: Every day. That is why we became so close.
Affinity_Eisia_EP17_007: What?! You are closer to Meluna than to me, Master? No! From now on, you will be closer to me! You and I are best friends now. Understood?!
Affinity_Eisia_EP18_001: When I retire, I am thinking of living on Elemental Mountain, where Aya lives.
Affinity_Eisia_EP18_003: I do not know. But would Aya not like it too? She has always been alone and lonely. If she lives with me, she will never be lonely again~
Affinity_Eisia_EP18_004: Did the spirits agree to that?
Affinity_Eisia_EP18_005: Why do I need their permission? I want to live there! Give me freedom of residence!
Affinity_Eisia_EP18_007: That is not it. I have lived a long and fierce life in Monatium, so I would like to try living somewhere else too...!
Affinity_Eisia_EP19_001: What company benefits would my employees enjoy?
Affinity_Eisia_EP19_003: They seem to help themselves already. I warned them countless times not to eat the ice cream in the company freezer, but they do it every day. I have given up.
Affinity_Eisia_EP19_005: Paid? Is that leave for employees who failed to earn a promotion? As a form of consolation...? Hmm... I shall consider it.
Affinity_Eisia_EP19_007: Then my company needs no benefits! Overtime is standard, and naturally we work holidays from time to time too~ Hehe!
Affinity_Eisia_EP20_001: I will create the ultimate ice cream that no race can resist eating!
Affinity_Eisia_EP20_002: Good! A dream should be grand.
Affinity_Eisia_EP20_003: When that happens, Meluna will fall over herself begging me for just one ice cream, right? Kahahaha!!!
Affinity_Eisia_EP20_005: You are afraid I truly might create it, are you not? Teasing you with that ice cream while you are desperate to eat it would be great fun! Kahaha!
Affinity_Eisia_EP20_006: Is that not an overly unrealistic dream?
Affinity_Eisia_EP20_007: No~? Not at all. In fact, my true dream is even greater. This is merely something I shall accomplish as a matter of course~ Ahem!
